newsitem.title: USA: Castle Harlan partnership buys Charlie Brown's chain.
newsitem.headline: Castle Harlan partnership buys Charlie Brown's chain.

text.p: Investment group Castle Harlan said Tuesday it expanded its restaurant interests with the $50.4 million purchase of Charlie Brown's, Inc., a restaurant company that operates in New Jersey and Westchester County, N.Y.
Senior management of Charlie Brown's also participated in the acquisition from Restaurant Associates Corp.
Charlie Brown's, based in Mountainside, N.J., owns and operates 24 Charlie Brown's Steakhouses and six restaurants called The Office Beer Bar & Grill.

Charlie Brown's is the first acquisition by Castle Harlan Partners III, an investment partnership managed by New York merchant bank Castle Harlan Inc. In recent years, Castle Harlan partnerships have made several major investments in restaurant chains, including Morton's of Chicago steakhouses and McCormick & Schmick's, operator of 16 upscale seafood restaurants, primarily in the western United States.
